options.title: Settings
options.aimForSizeHint: Searches for the quality that lands just under your limit
options.metadataHint: Camera and date survive. Where you were does not.
options.convertToSrgbHint: Wide-gamut photos look over-saturated in apps that ignore the profile
options.backgroundHint: This format has no transparency. Pick what replaces it.
options.namesKept: Names are kept as they are
options.wouldCollide: Every file would get the same name. Add {name} or {index}.

tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameDetail: The original name, without its extension

options.presetsEmpty: Save these settings to reuse them without rebuilding them.

pdf.lockedHint: The password is used to open the file and is never saved, sent, or written anywhere.
pdf.wrongPassword: That password did not open it.
pdf.pagesHint: Leave it empty for every page, or write something like 1-3, 7, 9-
pdf.rangeMatchesNothing: That range does not match any pages
pdf.pngLossless: PNG is lossless, so there is no quality to choose. Larger files, exact pixels.
pdf.orderHint: Documents are joined in the order you picked them.
pdf.rangesHint: Each range becomes its own document
pdf.flattensBody: Every page is redrawn as an image, so the result cannot be selected, searched, or read aloud. Neither platform can shrink a PDF without doing this. Keep the original if any of that matters.
pdf.grayscaleHint: Halves the size of a scanned document at no readable cost

incoming.title: Sent here
incoming.whatToDo: WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO DO?
incoming.unreadable_one: One file could not be identified and will be left out.
incoming.unreadable_other: {{count}} files could not be identified and will be left out.
incoming.nothingUsableBody: These files are not in a format this app reads. Images and PDFs both work.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Conversions you run will be listed here, on this device. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is shared.
history.entryHint: Shows the file names and lets you remove this entry

errors.unreadable: This file could not be opened. It may have been moved or deleted since you picked it.
errors.unsupportedSource: This format is not supported on this device. Older Android versions cannot read HEIC.
errors.unsupportedTarget: This device cannot write that format. Choose a different output format.
errors.corrupt: This file is damaged or incomplete, so it cannot be read. Try downloading it again.
errors.outOfMemory: This image is too large to process right now. Close other apps and try again.
errors.diskFull: There is not enough free space to save the result. Free up some space and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: Saving needs permission to add photos. You can grant it in Settings.
errors.passwordRequired: This PDF is password protected. Enter its password to continue.
errors.wrongPassword: That password did not work. Check it and try again.
errors.downloadFailed: This file is stored in the cloud and could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong converting this file. Try again.
